{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Many Imperial worlds are under some austerity program, and the ones that don't have New Order on the brain. There, you wouldn't know a decent holoboard if you saw one. Celanon, Nar Shaddaa, Ixtlar &mdash; plenty of worlds got a multicolored skyline &mdash; but even they pale before the shine of a Corporate Sector world.|Han Solo|<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
A '''holoboard''' was an advertising platform. They were prevalent throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]].
